At the Grave of the Nameless, the custom is to take one and leave one. The stones are weald sandstone, marches slate, black glass of the reach. One is starstone.

Within the year, someone always carries it back.
cards.textTemplate: Gain {strength} Strength. Exhaust.

cards.name: Iron Skin
cards.flavor:
Plate of cold iron, worn where a flame-mark would lie.

First worn by the ice-fishers of the Pale Marches in the year of the Decree, when the Court's brand-men came for the unmarked. Such plates are left upon the Grave of the Nameless for those who climb after.

Most have been worn thin by more than one wearer.
cards.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block.

cards.name: Field Dressing
cards.flavor:
Clean rag, tied to the cairn.

Boiled by someone who expected to need it, and did not return for it. The custom reached the hamlets with Chapel refugees after the Burning; the hamlets kept the custom, and let the prayer go.

Some rags arrive embroidered with names. The hamlets unpick them.
cards.textTemplate: Heal {heal} HP. Exhaust.

cards.name: Hex
cards.flavor:
Sign scratched upon a door.

The hamlets mark it on houses where someone marked burns slowly within, to keep it from coming out. They learned the sign from the Chapel, which set it upon the houses of the unmarked before the Decree.

The hamlets call it fair to use it the other way round.
cards.textTemplate: Apply {weak} Weak and {vulnerable} Vulnerable. Exhaust.

cards.name: Transmute
cards.flavor:
Cinder spent in the palm.

For a moment, the hand that holds it does not shake. The hamlets hold that each cinder was someone once, and forbid spending a cinder one took oneself.

Those who return from the ring have mostly broken that rule.
cards.textTemplate: Gain {gainEnergy} Stamina. Draw {draw} card. Exhaust.

cards.name: Twin Fang
cards.flavor:
Two knives, worn crosswise.

One for the hound, one for its handler. The weald's blight-hounds were the Wardens' before the Burning, and run yet with Bastion kennelmen who turned with the pack.

A handler may be reasoned with, briefly. Never twice.
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage {hits} times.

cards.name: Blinding Sand
cards.flavor:
Ash thrown in the eyes.

The hamlets learned in the first winter that what came out of the weald flinched from ash as the living do. Some took this as proof the corrupted could be saved.

Marl's Hollow took it as proof they could be blinded. Marl's Hollow endures.
cards.textTemplate: Apply {weak} Weak to ALL enemies. Exhaust.

cards.name: Hamstring
cards.flavor:
Cut at the back of the leg.

Taught upon the road with a single instruction: all things of the ring walk, so go for the legs. The saying is scratched on cairns from the weald to the coast, weeks apart.

It is cut in the same hand on every one.
cards.textTemplate: Apply {vulnerable} Vulnerable to ALL enemies. Exhaust.

cards.name: Master of Strategy
cards.flavor:
Maps scratched upon cairn stones.

Left by climbers who came back down, or meant to. The hamlet councils copy the true ones and burn the rest, and each winter argue which were which.

The oldest shows a fourth road leading off the ring toward the coast. It has not been burned.
cards.textTemplate: Draw {draw} cards. Exhaust.

cards.name: Bashing Blow
cards.flavor:
Blow of whatever is heavy.

A cudgel, a mallet, a shovel from a mine camp. The reach's miners swing it at things in the lower galleries that were miners once. Foreman Coll says not to look at their hands, which remember the work.

His camp has lost fewer than any other.
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage and {poiseDamage} Poise damage.

cards.name: Quick Guard
cards.flavor:
Arm raised upon the viaduct.

The viaducts are older than the kingdom, and have no rails. Climbers say they were built to carry heat, not people. Those who cross learn to keep one arm raised against the wind.

The stone has never learned to expect feet.
cards.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block. Draw {draw} card. Exhaust.

cards.name: Sweeping Blow
cards.flavor:
Wide swing for the viaduct.

Where the corrupted come three abreast and the stone is narrow. The Forsaken councils teach that the viaducts were always built to funnel something, long before there were corrupted to funnel.

The corrupted walk them because the stone expects a crowd.
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage to ALL enemies.

cards.name: Enfeeble
cards.flavor:
Sea salt, rubbed into a wound.

The ship-breakers swear by it. Salt, they say, is the one thing upon the ring the fire has never touched, for nothing written survives the sea.

They have not seen what the Tidebound Abbey keeps in its boathouse.
cards.textTemplate: Apply {vulnerable} Vulnerable to ALL enemies. Exhaust.

cards.name: Colossus Smash
cards.flavor:
Blow at the joints of something vast.

Learned against the Goldbough Avatar, the heraldic idol kneeling in a clearing of the weald, a sapling grown through it. It does not know the kingdom is gone.

It is carved stone and gilt. It flinches all the same.
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. Apply {vulnerable} Vulnerable.

cards.name: Mind Spike
cards.flavor:
A needle of thought, set where the doubt already lives.

The Starwatch drilled its apprentices to name a stranger's fear before the stranger did. The best of them could do it across a courtyard, and the worst of them could not stop.

The lens room was always quiet after the drill.
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. Psychic damage leaves the target Confused.

cards.name: Dissonance
cards.flavor:
Two true notes, struck a hair apart.

The Observatory's choir was forbidden the interval, for it turned the listener's own voice against the throat. Cantors who sang it by accident forgot their next line for a week.

The choir book still lists it, struck through twice.
cards.textTemplate: Apply {confused} Confused and {silenced} Silenced. Draw {draw} card.

cards.name: Mind Fracture
cards.flavor:
A crack drawn through the self.

The Starwatch's examiners tested apprentices by asking which memory they would give up. The ones who answered quickly were sent to the lower lenses. The ones who hesitated were kept.

Neither group was told what the examiners took.
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage and {poiseDamage} Poise damage. Apply {confused} Confused.

cards.name: Waking Nightmare
cards.flavor:
The dream does not end when the eyes open.

Apprentices who slept at the long lens woke describing rooms the Observatory never built. The Astronomer logged them as visions. The cleaning staff logged them as tenants.

Both logs agree the rooms were occupied.
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. Apply {confused} Confused. May add {sleep} Sleep buildup.

cards.name: Stone Sling
cards.flavor:
A pebble from the broken stair, thrown with the whole wrist.

The Basalt Stair porters kept a sling in each apron to scatter the crows from the grain. The crows learned to leave. The Stair's other visitors were slower learners.

The porters have not been paid in years and still keep their slings oiled.
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. Earth damage leaves the target Slowed.

cards.name: Rockfall
cards.flavor:
The ceiling remembers it was a hill.

The Chapel's masons propped their vaults with lime and trust. Where the trust ran out, the hill came back down in a single afternoon, and the masons wrote it up as maintenance.

The ledger shows no survivors in the maintenance column either.
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage to ALL enemies. Earth damage leaves each target Slowed.

cards.name: Stoneskin
cards.flavor:
The body takes the temper of the quarry.

Bastion masons rubbed grit into their forearms until the grit stayed. They said a wall that forgets to be a wall is only a heap, and a mason who forgets is the same.

The hardest of them could not be moved, and some of them could not move.
cards.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block and {stoneskin} Stoneskin: your Block is not removed at the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Entomb
cards.flavor:
The ground closes over a held breath.

Bastion engineers sealed a breached gallery with the breachers still inside, and entered the act in the log as repair. The stone has been warm to the touch ever since.

The gallery is still being repaired.
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. Apply {entombed} Entombed: it skips its next turn.

cards.name: Wound
cards.textTemplate: Unplayable.
cards.flavor:
A cut that closed wrong.

It knits into a hard ridge that aches before the weather turns. Climbers call it the road keeping its share.

The hamlets' older word for it means owed.

cards.name: Dazed
cards.textTemplate: Unplayable. Ethereal.
cards.flavor:
Light behind the eyes, left by a Grave Wisp.

Those who have seen a wisp up close say it looked at them as if reading.

Close your eyes. Do not speak your name until the light is gone.

cards.name: Slimed
cards.textTemplate: Exhaust.
cards.flavor:
Grey muck from the drowned hamlet.

It clings, and will not wash out in cold water. The hamlet flooded before the Burning, in a flood the Wardens called natural.

It is warmer than anything in the weald has a right to be.

cards.name: Guilt
cards.textTemplate: Unplayable. At the end of your turn, if this is in your hand, lose {loseHp} HP.
cards.flavor:
What follows looting at the Second Cairn.

The second time is easier. That is how climbers know the ring has begun on them.

cards.name: Rallying Banner
cards.textTemplate: An ally gains {block} Block.
cards.flavor:
Blank rag upon a pole.

Planted where climbers who meet upon the road may find one another. The Forsaken never had banners, for a banner bears a name. The corrupted come to them too.

A rag on a pole. Find it. Stand by it.

cards.name: Shared Flame
cards.textTemplate: An ally heals {heal} HP. Exhaust.
cards.flavor:
Warmth passed between two climbers.

Hands over one coal, breath beneath one coat, with no hearth and no ledger. The Chapel would have named it theft. It is the only warmth upon the ring owed to no one.

Warmth passed between two outlives the fire.

cards.name: Oath of Ash
cards.textTemplate: An ally gains {strength} Strength; you gain {strength.2}. Exhaust.
cards.flavor:
Oath sworn in ash.

A smear upon each other's wrist, where the mark would have been; no witness, no name. It binds twice, once for each. The Court held that an unwitnessed oath binds no one.

The Court is sewn to its oaths now.

cards.name: Guardian
cards.flavor:
Kite shield of the Court's knights, its strap cut short.

Such shields lie easily found upon the marches road, where the knights who bore them were stitched to their posts and left standing. Climbers take the shields and leave the knights.

The knights have not objected.
cards.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block. Add a temporary Enter: Bulwark to your hand. It costs 1 Stamina and Exhausts. Exhaust.

cards.name: Enter: Bulwark
cards.flavor:
The Wardens' holding stance, learned from the shield.

A shield that stood in the Bastion's line keeps the habit, the elders say, and pulls the arm into place. They call it superstition.

They tell climbers to carry Bastion shields, and never Court ones.
cards.textTemplate: Enter Bulwark Stance. Exhaust.

upgrade.textTemplate: Enter Bulwark Stance. Gain {block} extra Block. Exhaust.

cards.name: Bastion
cards.flavor:
Tower shield from the Bastion's walls.

Heavy as a door, nearly as tall. The Wardens set such shields in the embrasures to fight from, never to carry. Climbers carry them regardless, for a moving wall is better than a still one.

The weight bows the bearer forward, as the Wardens once bowed before the Bastion.
cards.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block. Gain {weak} Weak. Exhaust.

cards.name: Spiked Reprisal
cards.flavor:
Shield with nails driven through the boss.

The nails are from the Bastion's own gates. It is said a sellsword made it on the night of the Burning, from the gate he was hired to hold. His name is not known.

No bearer since has drawn the nails.
cards.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block. Prepare Melee Counter with {damage} base reply damage. Apply {bleed} Bleed.

cards.flavor:
Frost spear of the Pale Marches.

Its point was reforged from the broken blade of a Court knight, and marches steel keeps its frost long after leaving the cold. The ice-fishers who made it say the knight gave the blade freely, before the Decree, for a winter's fish.

The ice-fishers keep no records.
cards.name: Rime Thrust
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. Apply {frost} Frost.

cards.flavor:
Axe of the Dead Foundry.

The Foundry's fires went out with the Crown Flame, and its forges have been warm ever since, though none has lit them. Corran, a foundryman, broke this axe from a cold mould at dawn and carried it up the Basalt Stair.

He says no one poured it.
cards.name: Kiln Cleave
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. Apply {burn} Burn. Deal {poiseDamage} Poise damage.

cards.flavor:
Ward of the Chapel's evening bell-ringers.

A chime rung at vespers to close the day. Its bell was taken long ago; only the frame and the ward remain. Climbers who carry it say it rings at dusk regardless.

A Chapel ward, rung at vespers. The bell is gone.
cards.name: Vesper Ward
cards.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block. Gain {regen} Regen. Exhaust.

cards.name: Blighted Transmute
cards.textTemplate: Gain {gainEnergy} Stamina. Draw {draw} cards. Pay 12 Ashen Blight. Exhaust.
cards.flavor:
A borrowed breath leaves its name in ash.

The first black veins were mistaken for soot beneath the skin. Those who carried the mark learned that a borrowed breath left a debt after the flame had gone. Some grew stronger while counting it; none found the count growing smaller.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Blighted Second Bloom
cards.textTemplate: Heal {heal} HP. Draw {draw} card. Pay 15 Ashen Blight. Exhaust.
cards.flavor:
Black roots offer a second flowering.

The first black veins were mistaken for soot beneath the skin. Those who carried the mark learned that a borrowed breath left a debt after the flame had gone. Some grew stronger while counting it; none found the count growing smaller.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Blighted Blightward
cards.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} temporary Barrier. Draw {draw} card. Pay 10 Ashen Blight. Exhaust.
cards.flavor:
The brand shelters what it has begun to claim.

The first black veins were mistaken for soot beneath the skin. Those who carried the mark learned that a borrowed breath left a debt after the flame had gone. Some grew stronger while counting it; none found the count growing smaller.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Frost Counter
cards.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Prepare a frost Counter: 2 Ward and 1 Poise return.
cards.flavor:
Winter keeps the answering touch.

The Starwatch kept bowls of water beside the lenses through winter. Apprentices learned to read the skin of ice before it cracked. Their notes survived the Burning, folded inside cloth that still stiffens when a stranger touches it.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Fire Counter
cards.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Prepare a fire Counter: 2 Ward return.
cards.flavor:
The hearth sends another flame home.

The Bastion's night watch carried coals between the outer posts. A dying ember could reveal a footprint beneath fresh snow, or warn a sleeping guard before the gate gave way. Every watchman learned to keep the smallest flame alive.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Lightning Counter
cards.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Prepare a lightning Counter: 2 Ward return.
cards.flavor:
The returning current remembers every rail.

Storms found the Observatory's iron stairs long before any scholar could name their path. Apprentices marked the scorched rails, then wrapped their hands in dry cloth. The surviving diagrams begin with a warning to watch where the current returns.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Force Counter
cards.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Prepare a force Counter: 0 Ward and 3 Poise return.
cards.flavor:
A held weight waits for its answer.

At the Basalt Stair, porters steadied heavy crates without touching their broken handles. The Astronomer recorded the trick as a measured displacement. Those who carried the crates remembered only the sudden weight in their wrists when their concentration failed.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Alteration Counter
cards.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Prepare a alteration Counter: 1 Ward and 1 Poise return.
cards.flavor:
An old seam closes against the blow.

The Chapel's masons sealed cracks with dust gathered from the same stone. Their wards borrowed the patience of the wall rather than the strength of its builders. When the doors fell, several harmless seams remained closed against the rain.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Illusion Counter
cards.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Prepare a illusion Counter: 1 Ward and 1 Poise return.
cards.flavor:
The second reflection keeps its distance.

The apprentices worked beside darkened lenses until they could distinguish a reflection from its source. One kept a second chair for a companion nobody else remembered. The chair was found warm after the Observatory had stood empty for years.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Divine Counter
cards.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Prepare a divine Counter: 2 Ward return.
cards.flavor:
A patient lamp answers the darkness.

Pilgrims carried little lamps through the Chapel's long passages, tending each flame before their own food. The rite outlived the voices that taught it. An empty hand held over a stranger's wound still remembers the warmth of that watch.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Decay Counter
cards.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Prepare a decay Counter: 2 Ward return.
cards.flavor:
The bitter garden receives another seed.

Gardeners beneath the Chapel sifted bitter ash through exhausted soil. A root could be fed or strangled by the same handful, depending on the season. Their last ledger names each bed twice, once for its bloom and once for its silence.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Barrage Interception
cards.textTemplate: Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier. Prepare a alteration Counter: 1 Ward and 1 Poise return.
cards.flavor:
The last arrow finds a sheltered hand.

The Chapel's masons sealed cracks with dust gathered from the same stone. Their wards borrowed the patience of the wall rather than the strength of its builders. When the doors fell, several harmless seams remained closed against the rain.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Rime Needle
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. May add {frost} frost buildup; upcasting improves its chance.
cards.flavor:
A thin shard opens the winter.

The Starwatch kept bowls of water beside the lenses through winter. Apprentices learned to read the skin of ice before it cracked. Their notes survived the Burning, folded inside cloth that still stiffens when a stranger touches it.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. May add {burn} burn buildup; upcasting improves its chance.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Static Needle
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. May add {paralysis} paralysis buildup; upcasting improves its chance.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. May add {sleep} sleep buildup; upcasting improves its chance.
cards.flavor:
The lens holds a quiet drifting light.

The apprentices worked beside darkened lenses until they could distinguish a reflection from its source. One kept a second chair for a companion nobody else remembered. The chair was found warm after the Observatory had stood empty for years.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.flavor:

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. May add {crimsonBlight} crimsonBlight buildup; upcasting improves its chance.

Gardeners beneath the Chapel sifted bitter ash through exhausted soil. A root could be fed or strangled by the same handful, depending on the season. Their last ledger names each bed twice, once for its bloom and once for its silence.

cards.name: Phase Ward
cards.textTemplate: Gain {invulnerability} Invulnerability: avoid the next direct damaging action. Status buildup still applies. Exhaust.
cards.flavor:
The wall remembers an untouched seam.

The Chapel's masons sealed cracks with dust gathered from the same stone. Their wards borrowed the patience of the wall rather than the strength of its builders. When the doors fell, several harmless seams remained closed against the rain.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Illusion Decoy
cards.textTemplate: Gain {decoy} Decoy: avoid a Single Reach/Ranged damaging action. Status buildup still applies; Sweep and Holy reveal it.
cards.flavor:
A warm chair waits for an absent companion.

The apprentices worked beside darkened lenses until they could distinguish a reflection from its source. One kept a second chair for a companion nobody else remembered. The chair was found warm after the Observatory had stood empty for years.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Earth Grounding
cards.textTemplate: Gain {grounded} Grounded for 2 turns and clear pending Paralysis pressure.
cards.flavor:
The broken stair returns its thunder to stone.

The Chapel's masons sealed cracks with dust gathered from the same stone. Their wards borrowed the patience of the wall rather than the strength of its builders. When the doors fell, several harmless seams remained closed against the rain.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Restful Dream
cards.textTemplate: Gain {sleep} Sleep: lock ordinary cards and become vulnerable. Rest next turn within the combat healing and Ward caps.
cards.flavor:
A darkened lens shelters the weary eye.

The apprentices worked beside darkened lenses until they could distinguish a reflection from its source. One kept a second chair for a companion nobody else remembered. The chair was found warm after the Observatory had stood empty for years.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Sanctuary Cleanse
cards.textTemplate: Usable through Sleep, Paralysis and Dazed. Cleanse {removeStatus} Sleep, {removeStatus.2} Paralysis and {removeStatus.3} Dazed. Gain {gainBarrier} Barrier.
cards.flavor:
The little lamp is tended before the wound.

Pilgrims carried little lamps through the Chapel's long passages, tending each flame before their own food. The rite outlived the voices that taught it. An empty hand held over a stranger's wound still remembers the warmth of that watch.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Dream Harvest
cards.textTemplate: While an enemy is asleep, draw {draw} card. Once per turn; does not wake it.
cards.flavor:
The second chair receives a remembered guest.

The apprentices worked beside darkened lenses until they could distinguish a reflection from its source. One kept a second chair for a companion nobody else remembered. The chair was found warm after the Observatory had stood empty for years.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Lucid Recovery
cards.textTemplate: Break {removeStatus} Sleep. If asleep when played, gain {gainBarrier} Barrier.
cards.flavor:
The apprentice rises from the reflected chair.

The apprentices worked beside darkened lenses until they could distinguish a reflection from its source. One kept a second chair for a companion nobody else remembered. The chair was found warm after the Observatory had stood empty for years.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Grounded Resolve
cards.textTemplate: Break {removeStatus} Paralysis. If paralyzed when played, gain {grounded} Grounded.
cards.flavor:
Dry hands hold fast to the stone.

The Chapel's masons sealed cracks with dust gathered from the same stone. Their wards borrowed the patience of the wall rather than the strength of its builders. When the doors fell, several harmless seams remained closed against the rain.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Clear Head
cards.textTemplate: Clear {removeStatus} Dazed. If Dazed when played, your next Evade has Advantage. Once per turn.
cards.flavor:
Watch the shoulders before the blade.

Recruits practiced on the Bastion's worn courtyard until their boots found the same stones without looking. Veterans watched the shoulders rather than the weapon. After the Burning, the surviving lessons were passed from one tired pair of hands to another.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Low Guard Riposte
cards.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block. Counter Melee attacks for 3 Poise; +2 Poise while Prone.
cards.flavor:
The worn stones teach the lower answer.

Recruits practiced on the Bastion's worn courtyard until their boots found the same stones without looking. Veterans watched the shoulders rather than the weapon. After the Burning, the surviving lessons were passed from one tired pair of hands to another.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Crawling Shot
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage at Reach range. While Prone, prepare one Evade with Advantage.
cards.flavor:
A tired hand finds another line.

Recruits practiced on the Bastion's worn courtyard until their boots found the same stones without looking. Veterans watched the shoulders rather than the weapon. After the Burning, the surviving lessons were passed from one tired pair of hands to another.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Ember Covenant
cards.textTemplate: Your first Corrupted card each turn grants 3 Barrier. Blight still accumulates.
cards.flavor:
The watch accepts a coal that cannot be returned.

The Bastion's night watch carried coals between the outer posts. A dying ember could reveal a footprint beneath fresh snow, or warn a sleeping guard before the gate gave way. Every watchman learned to keep the smallest flame alive.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Shatter Opportunity
cards.textTemplate: Once per turn, thawing or shattering an enemy draws 1 card and Retains 1 card.
cards.flavor:
A cracked bowl leaves the water free.

The Starwatch kept bowls of water beside the lenses through winter. Apprentices learned to read the skin of ice before it cracked. Their notes survived the Burning, folded inside cloth that still stiffens when a stranger touches it.

The lesson outlived the hands that first carried it.

cards.name: Ward Armor
cards.textTemplate: Gain Persistent Block {base.persistent-block} and Persistent Barrier {base.persistent-barrier}.
cards.flavor:
Armor charm of the Bastion watch.

The ridge gates were held through long winters by guards too few to relieve one another. Their warding knots were tied into the lining, renewing a thin defense whenever the wearer could stand and breathe.

The cloth outlasted several suits of iron.

cards.name: Grease
cards.textTemplate: Apply Greased {base.greased}: fire detonates the coating.
cards.flavor:
Lamp oil prepared for the lower city's alleys.

Before the Burning, porters spread this heavy mixture beneath wheels to move stone uphill. The desperate later poured it across thresholds instead. Those who slipped could rise again, provided no one brought a torch.

The stair keeps both kinds of stain.

cards.name: Smite
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} weapon damage and {damage.2} Sacred damage.
cards.flavor:
Consecrated stroke of the Citadel knights.

A knight once carried the Court Flame's promise along the edge of a plain weapon. The oath was spoken before each watch, whether anyone remained to hear it or not. Some blades still answer the gesture.

The promise survived its intended keeper.

cards.name: Poison
cards.textTemplate: Apply {base.poison} Poison: 15 total Necrotic damage as it decays.
cards.flavor:
Bitter preparation of the weald's abandoned gardens.

The gardeners marked dangerous roots with white stakes so children could gather safely. When the Field Flame failed, the stakes were burned for warmth and the beds grew together. Their harvest now travels in stoppered bottles.

Nothing on the label promises a cure.

cards.name: Blight
cards.textTemplate: Apply Blight {base.blight}: lethal when its stacks reach current HP.
cards.flavor:
A wasting drawn from the Field Flame's ruins.

The first dark patches were cut from the orchards and buried beyond the walls. Shoots rose from the burial ground the following spring. By winter, the fruit within the city bore the same marks beneath its skin.

The gardeners ran out of clean ground.

cards.name: Weaken
cards.textTemplate: Apply Weak {base.weak}.
cards.flavor:
A loosening charm once laid upon dangerous beasts.

Wardens used these small workings to bring wounded animals home without further harm. After the Burning, the same gestures were taught at the gate. It was easier to carry a prisoner who could no longer struggle.

The hand remembers its gentler purpose.

cards.name: Charm
cards.textTemplate: Apply Charm {base.charm}.
cards.flavor:
A courtly working carried beyond the frozen bridges.

Petitioners learned to soften the attention of armed doorwardens before presenting their claims. The words lost their courtesy as the queues grew hungry. Their cadence still causes a raised weapon to hesitate before its appointed stroke.

An audience can be won without consent.

cards.name: Bind
cards.textTemplate: Apply Bind {base.bind}.
cards.flavor:
Restraint of the Bastion's old holding rooms.

The Wardens preferred a knot that checked the striking arm and left its bearer able to eat. Several survived on the empty cells after the keys were lost. Their pattern needs no rope when traced in ash.

Mercy had a shape before a name.

cards.name: Restrain
cards.textTemplate: Apply Restrained {base.restrained}. Add a Restrained burden to the enemy hand.
cards.flavor:
A burdening seal of the Court's prisoners.

Those brought over the bridges wore weighted cords beneath their sleeves. They could walk to judgment, but every movement reminded them of the escort. The cords rotted in the river vaults; the imposed weight remained in their knots.

The sentence travels lighter than its iron.

cards.name: Foresight
cards.textTemplate: Gain {base.foresight} Foresight and draw {draw} cards.
cards.flavor:
An exercise of the Observatory's night students.

Apprentices watched a candle's reflection through a bowl of dark water before they were allowed near the lenses. The practice taught them to notice a movement before seeking its cause. Few saw farther than the next breath.

That breath was sometimes sufficient.

cards.name: Evade
cards.textTemplate: Gain Evade {base.evade}.
cards.flavor:
Footwork of the weald's narrow river crossings.

Bridge keepers taught travelers to turn sideways when a laden cart passed. During the fighting, the movement became a way to let steel pass just as closely. It requires little ground, and leaves little room for doubt.

The river took those who stepped twice.

cards.name: Intangible
cards.textTemplate: Gain Intangible {base.intangible}.
cards.flavor:
A thinning learned among the Observatory's cold rooms.

Students were told to stand where the lens cast no image and listen for their own footsteps. Those who mastered the lesson could cross a door without stirring its hanging cloth. They returned colder than the stone.

The cloth never marked their passage.

cards.name: Mirrors
cards.textTemplate: Gain Mirrors {base.mirrors}.
cards.flavor:
A fractured defense of the river city's salons.

The old houses hung polished plates beside their doors to multiply a guest's arrival. After the bridges froze, household magicians learned to give those reflections a brief weight. Intruders struck the nearest figure and heard glass break.

The remaining guest need not be real.

cards.name: Elemental Weapon
cards.textTemplate: Enchant your weapon with Fire for {base.elemental-weapon} turns.
cards.flavor:
A furnace blessing carried on ordinary steel.

The Saints warmed the tools of workers assigned to the Observatory's outer stair. When the fuel carts stopped, a few tools retained their borrowed heat. Their owners discovered that the same blessing could be laid upon a blade.

The furnace asks no purpose of iron.

cards.name: Purifying Flame
cards.textTemplate: Take {damage} Fire damage. Remove Poison and Greased.
cards.flavor:
A harsh remedy of the Cinder Reach.

Mine workers burned spoiled dressings before returning beneath the ridge. In the last winters, the remedy was applied before the cloth was removed. Those who endured it escaped the creeping sickness, though none called the treatment gentle.

Clean flesh still bears the fire's account.

cards.name: Divine Cleanse
cards.textTemplate: Remove Weak, Bind and Restrained.
cards.flavor:
An unbinding rite of the Court Flame's attendants.

The attendants washed petitioners' hands before an oath could be heard. Later, they traced the washing gesture over fetters and old curses. The water was long gone, but the motion still persuaded certain bonds to loosen.

A clean hand can carry an old wound.

cards.name: Necrotic Renewal
cards.textTemplate: Convert incoming Necrotic damage to healing for {base.necrotic-healing} turns.
cards.flavor:
A forbidden recovery of the Furnace Chapel.

The sick were once kept apart from the Chapel's warm stones. A few learned to draw sustenance from the very cold that gathered around their beds. They survived to leave the rooms, carrying no warmth that others could share.

The cure did not restore their welcome.

cards.name: Profane Inversion
cards.textTemplate: Convert the enemy’s Sacred healing into damage for {base.divine-harm} turns.
cards.flavor:
An inversion found beneath the river city's shrines.

The shrines offered comfort to those whom the Court would not hear. After the Burning, their bowls filled with black water and the comforting words turned bitter. A practiced hand can direct that bitterness toward another's blessing.

The prayer arrives with its meaning reversed.

cards.name: Hand Shuffle
cards.textTemplate: Shuffle up to {draw} random hand cards into draw. Draw 3.
cards.flavor:
A road lesson taught with a traveler's worn cards.

Caravan guards changed their watches whenever the same sequence grew familiar. A dangerous habit could be broken by putting every expected duty aside and taking another. The method survived on roads where there were no caravans left.

Familiarity is a route an enemy learns.

cards.name: Deck Shuffle
cards.textTemplate: Shuffle the entire draw pile.
cards.flavor:
An ordering exercise of the Observatory's apprentices.

The students sorted loose charts until each could name their place by touch. Their teachers then scattered the stack and ordered them to begin again. The exercise continued after the charts ceased to describe the sky outside.

No arrangement was permitted to become certain.

cards.name: Draw
cards.textTemplate: Draw {draw} cards.
cards.flavor:
A preparation shared by the ring road's survivors.

Travelers kept a useful thing within reach and another beneath it, wrapped against the wet. Those who returned from the towers made the same small preparations before sleeping. A ready hand mattered more than a crowded pack.

The next necessity rarely announces itself.

cards.name: Retain
cards.textTemplate: Choose up to 2 hand cards to retain.
cards.flavor:
A keeper's habit from the Bastion granaries.

When the harvest was sound, each storekeeper set aside a measure that could not be touched at market. The custom remained after the stores were emptied. Fighters learned to reserve a useful movement with the same stubborn care.

Hunger is not the only thing to anticipate.

cards.name: Scout
cards.textTemplate: Look at the top 3 cards. Choose their order.
cards.flavor:
A pathfinder's method on the old viaducts.

The first travelers after the Burning tested each arch with a weighted cord before bringing the others forward. They marked the sound stones in an order the wind could not erase. Later parties sometimes found the marks rearranged.

A known road must still be examined.

cards.name: Read Intent
cards.textTemplate: Gain {base.read-intent}. Reveal the selected enemy's intent and burden hand for 1 turn.
cards.flavor:
A watcher's discipline of the Citadel bridges.

Doorwardens learned to read a visitor's hands before accepting any spoken purpose. The habit became more exact when the river froze and armed supplicants arrived together. A pause at the wrist could reveal more than a drawn blade.

Intent leaves a mark before iron moves.

cards.name: Recall
cards.textTemplate: Choose a discarded card to return to hand.
cards.flavor:
A recovery drill of the Bastion's shield yard.

Novices were made to repeat a failed movement after every other student had taken a turn. The delay stripped away haste and left the motion clear. Veterans carried the drill into fights that offered no patient teacher.

What was abandoned need not be lost.

cards.name: Exile Recovery
cards.textTemplate: Choose an exhausted card to return to hand.
cards.flavor:
An old retrieval practiced at the Observatory's refuse stair.

Broken instruments were cast into a pit beneath the workshops. Poor apprentices climbed down for pieces the masters considered spent. Sometimes a discarded lens revealed a star the great glass had missed for an entire season.

The refuse retained its own small light.

cards.name: Chosen Exhaust
cards.textTemplate: Choose a hand card to exhaust.
cards.flavor:
A deliberate sacrifice of the road's traveling schools.

A climber cannot carry every lesson into every chamber. Teachers made their pupils lay one practiced movement aside before opening a difficult door. The empty place left room for attention, though the surrendered habit sometimes proved hard to recover.

Readiness has always required a leaving behind.

cards.name: Transform
cards.textTemplate: Transform a chosen hand card into Strike for this combat.
cards.flavor:
A simplifying art of the Bastion's oldest instructors.

The instructors stripped elaborate exercises back to the first straight blow whenever a pupil grew confused. Finer details could be learned again after the hands stopped trembling. In the towers, that patient correction became a swift and necessary spell.

A beginning can still serve an ending.

cards.name: Staggering Burden
cards.textTemplate: Add 2 Stagger burdens to the enemy deck.
cards.flavor:
A stumbling curse carried in the Court's broken bells.

The bridge bells once kept the procession moving at a measured pace. When their towers fell, the sound arrived in uneven fragments. Those who caught its rhythm faltered in midstride, as though the next stone had been taken away.

The missing beat leaves a place for steel.

cards.name: Paralyzing Burden
cards.textTemplate: Add 2 Paralysis burdens to the enemy deck.
cards.flavor:
A locking curse of the river city's empty cells.

The gaolers kept certain prisoners still without tightening their chains. Its pattern was scratched into the doorframes for a replacement watch to learn. The cells are open now, but the old instruction can still seize a living limb.

An open door does not release everything.

cards.name: Exhaust
cards.textTemplate: Heal {heal} HP. Exhaust.
cards.flavor:
A final reserve of the road's exhausted climbers.

Those who reached a landing wounded sometimes bound their last clean cloth around their chest and stood. There would be no second dressing at the next stair. The resolve of that moment became a working taught without ceremony.

The cloth is spent before the climb is.

cards.name: Ethereal
cards.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block. Ethereal.
cards.flavor:
A brief shelter drawn from the Observatory's fading glass.

The outer windows once softened the heat that gathered beneath the great lens. Shards carried away after the Burning could still hold a pale screen for an instant. In an unwatched hand, they crumbled before the next breath.

The shelter lasts only while it is needed.

cards.name: Empower
cards.textTemplate: Gain {strength} Strength for this combat.
cards.flavor:
A strengthening rite of the Bastion's stone carriers.

Laborers pressed both palms against the first block before beginning the morning's lift. The gesture steadied tired arms through a day on the ridge. Their descendants found the same borrowed resolve useful beneath a weapon's weight.

Stone taught the hand before steel did.

cards.name: Shared Sacrifice
cards.textTemplate: All allies lose {loseHp} HP. Gain {block} Block.
cards.flavor:
A shared defense of the ring road's last escorts.

An escort sometimes closed ranks around the weakest traveler and bore the blows together. A harsher working drew the price from every companion before any enemy struck. The traveler it saved was left to remember each willing face.

Shelter can leave wounds on either side.

cards.name: Affliction Scaling
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage, scaling with distinct negative statuses.
cards.flavor:
A cruel calculation of the river city's interrogators.

The interrogators kept separate marks for cold, hunger, and the smaller pains inflicted between questions. Each new mark narrowed a prisoner's remaining resistance. Their successors learned to strike where several afflictions had already begun their work.

The ledger counted injuries as opportunities.

cards.name: Reprisal Growth
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage, scaling with HP lost this turn.
cards.flavor:
A reprisal taught among the Bastion's battered gate guards.

Relief seldom came before the second assault. The guards learned to turn the force that drove them backward into the next blow forward. Those who survived could tell the cost of a watch by its last strike.

The gate remembered every attempt to break it.

cards.name: Discipline Growth
cards.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block, scaling with distinct types played this turn.
cards.flavor:
A defense assembled from the ring road's scattered schools.

The towers once demanded separate loyalties from their fighters. On the roads between them, survivors exchanged the movements that had kept them alive. A guard became stronger when it could answer more than one kind of danger.

No ruined school could afford its old pride.

cards.name: Shifting Cost
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. Costs +1 SP per prior play this combat (maximum +3).
cards.flavor:
An exacting stroke of the Citadel's formal duels.

A duelist was expected to end the matter before fatigue spoiled the prescribed line. Those forced to repeat it found the weapon heavier on each return. The body paid for an elegance that the watching Court rarely questioned.

A perfect motion does not become easier.

cards.name: Rising Damage
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage, increasing each time this card is played.
cards.flavor:
A relentless exercise of the Bastion's quarry fighters.

Stone breakers struck along one line until the hidden fault yielded. Their children brought the practice into the shield yard, refusing to change a stroke that had not yet found its depth. Each return carried the weight of the last.

The fracture arrives before the stone admits it.

cards.name: Channel X
cards.textTemplate: Spend all remaining SP. Deal {damage} damage.
cards.flavor:
An undivided exertion of the road's solitary climbers.

A locked stair offers no promise of another attempt. Some climbers learned to gather every remaining measure of effort into one committed motion. What followed depended on whether the obstruction or the climber gave way first.

Nothing was kept for the next landing.

cards.name: Spread X
cards.textTemplate: Spend all remaining SP. Deal {damage} damage to up to X enemies.
cards.flavor:
A widening assault of the Bastion's crowded breach drills.

The instructors packed the yard with wooden figures when recruits grew too certain of a single opponent. A fighter learned to carry one movement across as many openings as their strength allowed. The yard left no place to rest.

A breach seldom admits only one enemy.

cards.name: Conceal
cards.textTemplate: Gain {base.conceal} Conceal. Hide X hand cards for X turns, where X is your Conceal stacks.
cards.flavor:
A concealment practiced by the river city's couriers.

Messages were sewn inside an empty fold rather than beneath a conspicuous seal. Some couriers learned to put the fold itself beyond a searcher's touch. What they hid returned later, sometimes after its appointed recipient was gone.

An absent thing can still keep its appointment.

cards.name: Force Stance
cards.textTemplate: Force the enemy into Defend.
cards.flavor:
A coercive feint of the Citadel's shield masters.

The masters taught a threatening step that made an opponent cover before choosing to do so. In practice the wooden blade stopped short. Beyond the yard, the same step could close a fighter inside a defense they had not intended.

A guard can become its own confinement.

cards.name: Many Forms
cards.textTemplate: Gain {base.many-forms} Many Forms: hold up to 2 stances until next turn.
cards.flavor:
A divided discipline of the road's wandering instructors.

No tower trained a pupil to hold two answers at once. The travelers who taught between the seats had fewer certainties and more scars. They learned to keep one motion ready while the body seemed committed to another.

The road required room for a second lesson.

cards.name: Stance Echo
cards.textTemplate: Smash: deal 12 damage. Otherwise gain {damage} Block.
cards.flavor:
An answering form of the Bastion's shield yard.

The same turn of the shoulder served different purposes under different weights. With a raised weapon it drove forward; behind a settled guard it closed the opening. Instructors judged the footing before they corrected the hands.

The body gives a motion its meaning.

cards.name: Resource Echo
cards.textTemplate: If MP was paid, deal {damage} damage; otherwise gain 8 Block.
cards.flavor:
A borrowed cadence of the Observatory's armed attendants.

Some attendants could kindle a spell along the motion of a blade. Others repeated the same motion without its light and found it settled into a serviceable guard. Both remained in the drills after the teachers stopped distinguishing them.

The hand remembers whether it carried fire.

cards.name: Strike and Settle
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage, then choose a maneuver stance.
cards.flavor:
A returning stroke of the Bastion's gate watches.

The first instruction was never to leave the weapon where the blow ended. Guards practiced finding a new footing while the edge was still returning. Those who forgot were corrected by a wooden staff across the unprotected ribs.

A strike ends only when its bearer is ready.

cards.name: Reframe
cards.textTemplate: Choose a hand card. Change its maneuver to Smash this combat.
cards.flavor:
A forceful correction of the Citadel's dueling schools.

Instructors sometimes placed a heavier practice blade into a pupil's hands without warning. A familiar technique then required a different commitment of shoulder and hip. The lesson was carried into battle by fighters who could no longer choose their tools.

The old motion accepted a different weight.

cards.name: Extend
cards.textTemplate: Choose a hand card. Change its range to Reach this combat.
cards.flavor:
An extending art of the weald's polearm keepers.

The keepers borrowed the motions of shorter weapons when the bridge left no room for a proper swing. A loosened grip and a careful step gave the remembered stroke another span. Its origin remained visible only to a patient teacher.

Distance changes the reach of an old lesson.

cards.name: Extra Weapon
cards.textTemplate: Gain {base.extra-weapon} extra weapon action this turn.
cards.flavor:
A second opening of the Bastion's veteran guards.

The newest recruits counted attacks as separate exertions. Veterans learned to keep the weapon moving while the first opponent still recoiled, finding another opening before the line closed. The extra stroke depended on preparation made before either enemy moved.

The interval belonged to the ready hand.

cards.name: Extra Shield
cards.textTemplate: Gain {base.extra-shield} extra shield action this turn.
cards.flavor:
A returning defense of the Citadel's bridge watches.

Two guards once shared each narrow post, turning their shields in a practiced sequence. After the watches thinned, a survivor had to answer both parts alone. Their descendants learned the second turn without ever seeing the partner it replaced.

The empty post still has its appointed movement.

cards.name: Automatic Counter
cards.textTemplate: Prepare one automatic counterattack. base.auto-counter: {base.auto-counter}.
cards.flavor:
A waiting answer of the Bastion's shield masters.

Pupils stood behind a raised board while the instructor struck it without a count. They were forbidden to pursue the staff and taught instead to answer its contact. Years later, some could begin the reply before knowing they had been attacked.

The lesson waited in the arm.

cards.name: Automatic Sweep
cards.textTemplate: Prepare one automatic sweep. base.auto-sweep: {base.auto-sweep}.
cards.flavor:
A prepared circle of the ring road's caravan guards.

An escort surrounded by thieves could not watch every approach. Guards planted their feet and learned to turn at the first touch of a blade. The motion cleared space for the travelers, even when its bearer never saw the attacker.

The road was measured by the weapon's return.

cards.name: Reflect
cards.textTemplate: Reflect eligible incoming damage for {base.reflect} turn.
cards.flavor:
A returning ward of the Observatory's polished chambers.

The lens workers fitted their masks with silvered plates against sudden flares. A few plates sent more than light back toward its origin. The attendants preserved the pattern after the workshops emptied, though the reflected pain had no brightness.

What strikes the surface finds its way home.

cards.name: Interpose
cards.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block and guard allies for {base.guard-allies} turn.
cards.flavor:
A sheltering oath of the Bastion's road wardens.

The Wardens walked between the wagons and the tree line, keeping their shields toward the unseen ground. An escort was judged by who arrived behind them, rather than by wounds received. The oath endured after the wagons stopped coming.

An empty road can still be guarded.

cards.name: Transmute
cards.textTemplate: Exhaust a chosen hand card. Gain {addCinders} cinders.
cards.flavor:
A frugal working of the Cinder Reach's traveling smiths.

Broken tools were weighed before they entered the furnace, and nothing useful was thrown away whole. Some smiths learned to draw cinders from a spent working with the same care. The recovered warmth bought another small necessity along the road.

What is surrendered leaves something in the palm.

cards.name: Spell Scroll
cards.textTemplate: Cast Foresight. One play per combat; exhaust this scroll.
cards.flavor:
A foresight exercise copied by an Observatory apprentice.

The student traced each curve slowly enough to remember the next before the ink dried. A traveler could later borrow that moment of clarity by opening the sheet. Its careful lines blackened as soon as they were read.

The lesson survived for one more pupil.

cards.name: Resource Gain
cards.textTemplate: Restore {restoreStamina} SP.
cards.flavor:
A measured recovery of the weald's ridge workers.

Workers rested at marked stones on the climb to the Bastion, setting their loads down before their knees failed. The short interval was counted in steady breaths. Fighters learned to find the same recovery without leaving their place in the line.

Rest need not wait for a safe road.

cards.name: Ally Empowerment
cards.textTemplate: Give an ally {strength} Strength for this combat.
cards.flavor:
An encouragement kept by the Bastion's shared watches.

The guards touched a companion's shoulder before exchanging places at the gate. A small working grew around the gesture, lending tired arms some of the giver's resolve. It passed between survivors long after the gate ceased to stand.

The hand is withdrawn; the steadiness remains.

cards.name: Ward Break
cards.textTemplate: Deal 8 Ward damage.
cards.flavor:
A disrupting touch of the Observatory's instrument keepers.

The keepers tested old seals before moving a lens from its housing. A precise disturbance could loosen a ward without shattering the glass beneath it. The method later found use against defenses made to protect less delicate things.

The opening is smaller than the harm it permits.

cards.name: Poise Break
cards.textTemplate: Deal {poiseDamage} Poise damage.
cards.flavor:
A staggering blow of the Bastion's quarry crews.

Quarry workers drove wedges where the weight of a block already strained its bed. A short stroke could unsettle stone too large to break outright. Their fighting descendants sought the same yielding place beneath armor and planted feet.

What cannot be broken can still be moved.

cards.name: Smash Creation
cards.textTemplate: Add a temporary Smash to hand.
cards.flavor:
A recalled stroke of the Citadel's heavy weapon drills.

A recruit carried a wooden mallet before being trusted with the armory's iron. Instructors made its simple downward path the last exercise of every watch. Even an empty hand could remember the weight when no suitable weapon remained.

The practiced burden waits for another shape.

cards.name: Conditional Strike
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage. In Smash stance, deal {damage.2} more.
cards.flavor:
A committed strike of the Bastion's breach fighters.

The guards held their heavier blows until their footing could carry the whole body forward. Striking from an unsettled guard wasted the opening and often the weapon. The old drill made patience part of an apparently reckless motion.

The strength was waiting beneath the stance.

cards.name: Veil
cards.textTemplate: Become untargetable without a perception check for {base.veil} turns.
cards.flavor:
A veiling art of the river city's hidden messengers.

Couriers crossed occupied bridges by moving where a watcher's attention had just departed. A small working deepened that omission until a searching gaze passed over them. Those with a practiced eye could still find the disturbance in the crowd.

A missing figure leaves an occupied space.

cards.name: Hold Block
cards.textTemplate: Gain {block} Block. Retain Block for {base.retain-block} turn.
cards.flavor:
A settled guard of the Citadel's long watches.

The bridge guards learned to hold their shields through the quiet between assaults without letting the shoulders slacken. Their stance preserved work already done instead of demanding it anew. The practice remained useful when the bridges became a frozen road.

The pause does not belong to the attacker.

cards.name: Flowing Transition
cards.textTemplate: Immediately choose a maneuver stance.
cards.flavor:
A passing form of the road's traveling duelists.

A lesson borrowed in one city rarely answered every danger in the next. Travelers practiced changing their footing between breaths rather than between engagements. Those who managed it could leave an old commitment before an enemy found its opening.

The road did not wait for a formal beginning.

cards.name: Stagger
cards.textTemplate: Skip your next action when drawn. Ethereal.
cards.flavor:
An interruption carried by a broken bell's cadence.

The body seeks the missing beat and finds no footing. By the time its balance returns, the opening has already passed.

The next step belongs to someone else.

cards.name: Multiple Strikes
cards.textTemplate: Strike {hits} times for {damage} damage. Deal {poiseDamage} Ward and 3 Poise damage total.
cards.wardOffTextTemplate: Strike {hits} times for {damage} damage. Deal {poiseDamage} Poise damage total.
cards.flavor:
A repeated stroke of the weald's short-blade escorts.

In a crowded passage, there was no room to draw back for a great blow. Escorts learned to strike along the returning path, turning small openings into a succession of wounds. The enemy's guard had to answer every movement separately.

A narrow space need not mean a single chance.

cards.name: Paralysis
cards.textTemplate: Skip your next action when drawn. Ethereal.
cards.flavor:
A lingering command of the river city's gaolers.

The fingers close without taking hold of anything. The old restraint needs neither a chain nor a prisoner who remembers the charge.

Release comes after the moment it was needed.

cards.name: Restrained
cards.textTemplate: Your actions cost +1 SP while this burden is held. Ethereal.
cards.flavor:
A remembered weight from the Court's holding rooms.

The cord is gone, but each movement still pays its toll. Prisoners learned to make fewer gestures while waiting for a door to open.

The burden has outlived its fastening.

cards.name: Strike
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage.
cards.flavor:
A plain stroke shared by the ring road's survivors.

Each tower claimed a finer school, and each school began by teaching the hand to carry an edge straight toward its mark. Travelers kept that first lesson when the schools and their quarrels were left behind.

The simplest instruction still has work to do.

cards.name: Smash
cards.textTemplate: Deal {damage} damage.
cards.flavor:
A heavy stroke remembered from the Bastion's stone yards.

A block that resisted the first careful blow sometimes needed the whole weight of the worker behind the next. The motion passed from mallet to weapon without losing its patient preparation or its unkind finish.

The arm follows where the body has committed.

relics.name: Forsaken Medallion
relics.textTemplate: Max HP +{hpFlat}. Your first attack each combat also deals {poiseDamage} Poise damage.
relics.flavor: Its face is worn smooth, but it still remembers being gold.

relics.name: Starstone Shard
relics.textTemplate: Max HP +{hpFlat}. Mana +{manaFlat}. Magic damage +{magicDamageFlat}. Begin each combat with Starstone Charge and restore {restoreMana} Mana.
relics.flavor: A chip of someone else’s genius. It still hums.

relics.name: Cutpurse's Coin
relics.textTemplate: Begin each combat Prepared. Your first attack each combat applies {venom} Venom.
relics.flavor: One face buys silence. The other buys speed.

relics.name: Gold Figurine
relics.textTemplate: Whenever you heal, gain {block} Block (even at full HP).
relics.flavor: It is very small and very heavy and it loves you.

relics.name: Golden Sprout
relics.textTemplate: At the start of each combat, heal {heal} HP.
relics.flavor: A sapling waits inside, patient as grief.

relics.name: Whetstone Fragment
relics.textTemplate: Your first attack each combat deals {damage} extra damage.

relics.name: Kindling Charm
relics.textTemplate: At the start of each combat, draw {draw} extra card.

relics.name: Cinder Pouch
relics.textTemplate: Gain 25% more Cinders from combats.

relics.name: Feral Eye
relics.textTemplate: Elites offer an extra card reward choice.

relics.name: Goldleaf Charm
relics.textTemplate: At the start of your first turn, gain {block} Block.
relics.flavor: A single leaf, pressed flat, still gold. It keeps the wind off you.

relics.name: Cracked Lantern
relics.textTemplate: On your first turn each combat, gain {gainEnergy} Stamina.
relics.flavor: The glass is broken but the flame refuses to notice.

relics.name: Sacrificial Knife
relics.textTemplate: Your first attack each combat applies {bleed} Bleed.
relics.flavor: It was made to open things that were meant to stay closed.

relics.name: Cured Hide
relics.textTemplate: The first time you lose HP each combat, gain {block} Block. Poise threshold +2 (no current consumer).
relics.flavor: The beast learned its lesson too late to keep it.

relics.name: Ivory Comb
relics.textTemplate: Every 8th card you play each combat: draw {draw} card.
relics.flavor: Someone kept themselves tidy right up until the end.

relics.name: Cracked Tear
relics.textTemplate: Flasks are 50% stronger (rounded up).

relics.name: Sealstone Key
relics.textTemplate: Unknown (?) locations on the map are revealed.

relics.name: Fell Warden Brand
relics.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy Staggers, draw {draw} cards.

relics.name: Bloodied Talisman
relics.textTemplate: Whenever Bleed bursts, the victim loses {loseHp} additional HP.

relics.name: Ember Fragment
relics.textTemplate: Resting heals 15% more.

relics.name: Twinned Armor
relics.textTemplate: Every 10th card you play each combat: gain {block} Block.

relics.name: Blight-Touched Idol
relics.textTemplate: Your first attack each combat applies {crimsonBlight} Crimson Blight.
relics.flavor: The carving was of a saint. The blight made it a saint of something else.

relics.name: Warhorn
relics.textTemplate: At the start of each combat, gain {strength} Strength.
relics.flavor: One long note, and the old anger answers.

relics.name: Vow of Vengeance
relics.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy dies, gain {strength} Strength.
relics.flavor: Every name you take is a name you carry.

relics.name: Pearl of Sagacity
relics.textTemplate: Every 6th card you play each combat: gain {gainEnergy} Stamina.
relics.flavor: It clouds when you are foolish. It has been cloudy for some time.

relics.name: Blessed Dew
relics.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, heal {heal} HP.
relics.flavor: It gathers on the vial overnight, from nowhere, for no one.

relics.name: Azure Sigil
relics.textTemplate: The first Skill you play each combat: gain {gainEnergy} Stamina.
relics.flavor: Painted in a hand that trembled, by someone who steadied at the last stroke.

relics.name: Bloodstained Chalice
relics.textTemplate: Whenever Bleed bursts on an enemy, gain {block} Block.
relics.flavor: It fills a little more each time. You have stopped asking with what.

relics.name: Goldbough Sapling
relics.textTemplate: At the start of your turn, if you have no Block: gain {block} Block.

relics.name: Wyrm Heart
relics.textTemplate: Gain {gainEnergy} extra Stamina each turn. Shrines and chapels no longer offer Rest.
relics.flavor: It still beats. It expects something of you.

relics.name: Ancestral Horn
relics.textTemplate: Power cards cost 1 less.

relics.name: Titan's Cinder
relics.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, gain {strength} Strength.
relics.flavor: A giant died to make this. It is still furious about it.

relics.name: Radiant Aegis
relics.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, if you have Block: gain {block} Block.
relics.flavor: It rewards the guarded. It has nothing to say to the reckless.

relics.name: Flayer's Censer
relics.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, apply {crimsonBlight} Crimson Blight to ALL enemies.
relics.flavor: The smoke seeks out lungs. It is not particular about whose.

relics.name: Vigilant Halo
relics.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy Staggers, heal {heal} HP.
relics.flavor: It hovers a hand above your head, waiting for you to earn it.

relics.name: Carrion Talon
relics.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy dies, deal {damage} damage to a random enemy.
relics.flavor: The flock does not mourn. The flock moves to the next warm thing.

relics.name: Ember Idol
relics.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, deal {damage} damage to ALL enemies.
relics.flavor: It has been warm to the touch for a thousand years. It is patient about it.

relics.name: Crown of Stitches
relics.textTemplate: Begin each combat with {strength} Strength — and {frail} Frail. New limbs are heavy.
relics.flavor: It fits. That is the worst part.

relics.name: Warden Horn
relics.textTemplate: Draw {draw} extra card each turn. At the start of each combat, lose {loseHp} HP.
relics.flavor: It sounds without being blown. Something is answering.

relics.name: Ash of Remembrance
relics.textTemplate: Gain {gainEnergy} extra Stamina each turn. At the start of each combat, gain {madness} Madness.
relics.flavor: The dead lend strength. They are not gentle about it.

relics.name: Cinder of the Fallen
relics.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy dies, gain {gainEnergy} Stamina. At the start of each combat, gain {madness} Madness.
relics.flavor: It pays out in the coin of endings. It expects you to make more of them.

relics.name: Crimson Covenant
relics.textTemplate: Your attacks apply {bleed} Bleed. At the start of each combat, lose {loseHp} HP.
relics.flavor: The pact is simple: your blood answers for theirs. It is not a fair trade, but it is fast.

relics.name: Traveler's Whetstone
relics.textTemplate: At the start of each combat, gain {strength} Strength.
relics.flavor: It was sharpened by hands that are no longer here to use it.

relics.name: Moonlit Vial
relics.textTemplate: At the start of each combat, gain {block} Block.
relics.flavor: It never empties. It never fills, either.

relics.name: Warden's Lantern
relics.textTemplate: The first time you lose HP each combat, draw {draw} card.
relics.flavor: The flame gutters when you are hurt, then burns a little brighter.

relics.name: Salted Relic
relics.textTemplate: Gain 20% more Cinders from combats.
relics.flavor: It was buried to keep something in, or something out. No one remembers which.

relics.name: Hollowed Horn
relics.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy Staggers, apply {vulnerable} Vulnerable to ALL enemies.
relics.flavor: It sounds only once. Everything still standing flinches.

relics.name: Gilded Tear
relics.textTemplate: On your first turn each combat, heal {heal} HP.
relics.flavor: A single drop, hardened gold, wept for someone who never asked for it.

relics.name: Watchman's Badge
relics.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, if you are not Weak: gain {strength} Strength.
relics.flavor: It is pinned to a coat that has seen more watches than the man wearing it.

relics.name: Howling Standard
relics.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy Staggers, gain {strength} Strength.
relics.flavor: It has not fallen in a hundred routs. It does not intend to start with yours.

relics.name: Emberwick Charm
relics.textTemplate: The first time you lose HP each combat, gain {gainEnergy} Stamina.
relics.flavor: It burns brightest at the moment you can least afford to slow down.

relics.name: Carrion Morsel
relics.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy dies, heal {heal} HP.
relics.flavor: The spire feeds those who feed it. It is not fussy about the manners of the exchange.

relics.name: Gravetender's Bell
relics.textTemplate: Whenever an enemy dies, draw {draw} card.
relics.flavor: One toll for each name laid down. The tending is in the counting.

relics.name: Sentinel's Oath
relics.textTemplate: Every 12th card you play each combat: gain {strength} Strength.
relics.flavor: The oath is long and the watch is longer. Endurance is its own kind of edge.

relics.name: Forsaken Warflag
relics.textTemplate: At the start of each turn, apply {weak} Weak to ALL enemies.
relics.flavor: The colors are all but rotted away. What it musters now answers to no banner but yours.

relics.name: Wrath Coil
relics.textTemplate: Whenever you lose HP, deal {damage} damage to a random enemy.
relics.flavor: It winds tighter with every wound and lets go all at once, at someone else.

relics.name: Ashen Grip
relics.textTemplate: The first stance you enter each turn refunds {restoreStamina} Stamina.
relics.flavor: The leather remembers every hand that held it, and gives a little back.

relics.name: Lodestar Shard
relics.textTemplate: Begin each combat with {restoreMana} extra Mana.
relics.flavor: It points nowhere on any map. It points at the next cast.

relics.name: Waxen Seal
relics.textTemplate: The first time you heal each combat, heal {heal} more.
relics.flavor: Pressed once, it holds. Pressed twice, it is only wax.

relics.name: Whetstone Pouch
relics.textTemplate: Your first attack while Prepared each combat applies {bleed} Bleed.
relics.flavor: A thumb along the edge before the first cut. Habit, and then not.

relics.name: Wayfarer's Knot
relics.textTemplate: Gain 10% more Cinders from combats. Resting heals 10% more.
relics.flavor: One knot for the road ahead. One for the breath to walk it.

relics.name: Prismatic Thorn
relics.textTemplate: Your hits build 25% more Arcane Exposure. Flasks are 25% weaker (rounded up).
relics.flavor: It drinks the medicine and leaves the fever bright.

relics.name: Restless Clasp
relics.textTemplate: Flasks are 100% stronger. Resting heals 50% less.
relics.flavor: It keeps the medicine close and sleep far away.

relics.name: Pauper's Diadem
relics.textTemplate: Power cards cost 1 less (minimum 0). Gain 35% fewer Cinders from combats.
relics.flavor: The crown accepts your future earnings. It never asks what you will eat.

classes.name: Reaver
classes.description: Fights up close and switches footing mid-battle — one stance hits harder, the other holds the line. Wounds you land keep bleeding, and heavy blows stagger.

classes.name: Starseer
classes.description: Casts in sequence — the second spell each turn strikes harder than the first. Fragile early on, so the order you play cards matters more than their power.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: Sets up a clean opening, then turns speed, poison, and opportunism into decisive strikes before the enemy can recover.

classes.name: Herald
classes.description: Spends its own health to act, then heals it back. Spreads a rot that damages enemies over time. One pool for everything, so mistakes stack up fast.

basicCardProfiles.flavor:
Blow of the empty fist.

The last thing a Forsaken owns once the blade is broken and the cairn has kept it. No hamlet teaches it; it is learned the first winter a sword is traded for salt.

A last resort, still yours.

Rim-blow of the Bastion's shield line.

Climbers learn it from salvaged Warden shields, once gilded with the branch. Most scrape the gold away. The corrupted Wardens of the Fell Courtyard hesitate at the sight of it.

Some leave the gold.

Plain cut of Bastion steel.

Drilled into the field levies and the sellswords hired beside them. Weald smiths never signed their blades, a custom the Chapel's scribes thought insolent and never ended.

Unsigned steel can be carried without anyone asking whose it was.

Turning flurry of the Citadel's midwinter masque.

Court dancers spun double-ended blades before the throne. Stitched to their posts when the Court Flame died, some turn yet upon the frozen river, slower each winter.

Climbers learn the step by watching. The dancers do not mind.

Two quick openings, as the Court's surgeons let a vein.

Their apprentices taught it on the docks once the Court stopped paying them. One teaches it yet, for cinders, beneath the ice below the Citadel.

He learned to open people. He taught himself to close them, and does not sell that part.

Shot loosed from low cover.

The way weald poachers took the deer the Bastion kept for its tables. The Bastion hanged poachers, so the hamlets loosed upon the dawn peal, which hid the sound of the string.

The Bell Keeper rings the peal yet, though no dawn follows.

Cold light struck from an apprentice's staff.

Cut green from weald lanternwood and tipped with starstone bought from the reach miners. The Starwatch taught that the light came from the stone.

It came more easily with the staff turned skyward. The apprentices were told not to notice.

Working of a cantor's sceptre.

Chapel sceptres bore script copied from sealstone doors older than the Chapel. The cantors were taught its sounds, never its sense. The Chapel called the script sacred.

Among themselves, the cantors called it borrowed.

Empty-handed guard of the ice-fishers.

Weight low, feet wide, upon lakes that crack all winter and hold but one at a time. The fishers of Sallow Lake say the ice has a temper, and may be reasoned with.

Those who said otherwise are beneath it.

Haft-turn of the Bastion's field levies.

Sergeant Ilse drilled it upon the Muster Stair. On quiet nights her voice carries from the Bastion walls, calling the count.

The levies she drilled are corrupted now. When they hear her, they take their places.

Shield set against the blow, as the Wardens taught.

Bastion shields bore strips of bell-bronze upon the rim, cast from metal left when the great bell was founded. The Wardens said the bronze rang the hour when struck.

It rings at other hours too.

Ward drawn through a staff, taught upon Starwatch Terrace.

Where the apprentices measured the new tower's draw across the water. The Astronomer said the ward was against the salt wind.

It leaned toward the Spire whenever it was drawn.

Ward of the bier-watch.

Cantors held a sceptre crosswise over the dead through the night, before a name was written. The Chapel taught that it kept the name from wandering.

Where a name might wander, the rubric does not say.

Art of the empty hand.

Mostly the art of not being where the blow lands, taught by the ship-breakers upon hulls that shift with the tide. Gull-Bet calls it the first thing the Forsaken ever had that the marked envied.

That has been true for a very short while.

A weapon learned as it was last used.

Take up what the corrupted drop, and let its habits show. A blade taken from a Warden cuts like a Warden. Orla of the hamlets below the Bastion bears a sword that dips toward the Fell Courtyard as she passes.

She no longer fights the pull.

The poacher's pause before loosing.

Breath out, hand set, wait for the bell. Weald poachers learned patience from the Bastion's gamekeepers, who hanged the impatient. The gamekeepers walk the lanternwood yet, among the corrupted.

They count beneath their breath. The count never ends.

Breath set behind the focus.

Counted to the rhythm of the star tables, recited until the rhythm lived in the breath. The Starwatch taught the tables were only numbers; the apprentices held the rhythm older.

On the night of the eclipse, the Astronomer read the last table aloud, and did not stop at its end.
